examples.title: Use when Okay Nabu is heard
examples.explanation: Block notation: Starts an attached script when the board emits an Okay Nabu event. Event hat; a listener or clip check must be started separately.

notes: Local Okay Nabu keyword detection. The event runs on the board. Checking a saved audio clip or an installed synthetic test phrase does not start the microphone. The model profile is required.
